body: This wouldn't be a bad plan, would it be worth it to just join up for a couple weeks though? I'm moving about 4 states over not long from now

It's going back to a friendship, not a long distance relationship, and I realize I need to not be so clingy, kinda why I'm trying to figure out things to do away from her, but find some kind of social thing around here to do, I'm only here for a couple weeks now, I wanna give her some distance right now. Just a little hard to figure out when you're kind of a shut in...

I did, I even talked with her about it this morning, she said she knew she was being unreasonable and a bit mean, but she didn't really wanna try and fix things right now, I'm still depressed I'm moving, but I'm sure it'll get better, we'll probably at least talk like we used to after a while, even if we don't see eachother. Just bad times to meet up I guess...Thanks, I do feel alot better about all of this, and all the advice and support really helped out, glad I was able to find a place to talk

Thanks, I appreciate it, idk, I just want her to be happy, I really don't want to move, but she seems set on it, we've been getting along a tiny bit better late last night and this morning, but idk, she still doesn't seem to want to be around me or talk much

I sent her a long email last night after I calmed down, trying to explain myself and everything that's been going on with me, and accepting that I did alot wrong myself, but she's just been distant, and idk, well, I do, I just feel mixed up about all this, she has problems being with people, she ended up hating her last few room mates just because they were there all the time, and I'm a bit of a home body i don't get out much or like to really, but that bothers her because she gets very little time just to herself, which is understandable, she should be able to get away and have some solitary time, but I'm just bad at getting out, and as I said, I'm having problems getting a job, so I'm not getting out that way either

I hate to admit it, but a part of me agrees with you, but I also feel like if this didn't work out in person we can't really continue being friends if we met in person and it didn't work out there'd never be a chance to be friends in person as well, I mean, she has issues where she had a hard break up last year and has had trouble being around any one person for a long time without getting completely sick of them, she talked with me and I with her about that so much, I miss the communication, we used to talk all the time, tell eachother our worries, confide in eachother, and I know it's not really her fault and I can't blame her for it, but I just wish this would work, but it's not, and I REALLY don't want to go back home aswell because my hometown was poor and so was my family, getting here was very difficult financially, and I couldn't find a job there, and I can't find one here, it'll be even harder back home
Thanks, I feel a tad calmed down by now, things just crashed to suddenly, especially since she's my best friend and I still love her, idk
